scope.basis: Exact 95-candidate RUN-017 module scope, mechanically intersected with RUN-019.

adjudication_rule: Inspect canonical controllers, services, models, route consumers, and page owners at the pinned source. Route grouping alone is never decisive. A delivery endpoint merges into its user-job owner; a cohesive page or report family survives when it is itself a stable user job. Disclosure/download/export separates where authority or privacy differs.
authorization_boundary: Single tenant, multiple Sites: exact action capability plus approved-Site scope plus canonical record ownership plus concealed foreign direct IDs plus applicable privacy or sensitivity rules. Global Site visibility broadens scope only and never replaces action authority.
